ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the square $ABCD$, the diagonal $AC=4$. What is the perimeter of the square $ABCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that the diagonal $AC=4$,\\
hence $\sqrt{AB^{2}+BC^{2}}=4$,\\
since in square ABCD $AB=BC$,\\
thus $AB=BC=2\sqrt{2}$,\\
therefore, the perimeter of square ABCD is: $2\sqrt{2}\times 4=\boxed{8\sqrt{2}}$.
